A customized Maelstrom death-bringer that fires extremely illegal tri-ball explosive mini-shells. Known for turning enemies into unrecognizable piles of flesh. Warning: Requires extensive clean-up afterwards.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Snubnose Pistol

Damage: 6d6, Drop 2 Lowest • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Pistol Auto Sear and Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load custom High Explosive Ammunition (25eb per round), which can only be used by this weapon. Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional point of SP (2 SP Total). Attacks with this weapon on targets beyond 6m/yds suffer a -4 penalty to their Attack Check and deal 2d6 less damage (4d6, drop 2 lowest). Whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, the user rolls three times on the Critical Injury table, re-rolling any repeats, and chooses one of the results for the victim to suffer. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by sacrificing the user's Move Action as long as they have at least one other open hand.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Snubnose Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 6d6, dropping the 2 lowest dice. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
